soft_start.rack_reference: Typical Eurorack module: 10-47 uF per rail; 20 modules x 22 uF = 0.44 mF per rail. S7 isolated this through the eFuse/LM5067 dV/dt; S8 relies on the converter soft start
soft_start.note: track_ramp_max_C / max_C are TOTAL capacitance (onboard + rack); rack_allowance subtracts the onboard bank at its high corner. Loads that draw less than the full target during start-up leave more room (no_load column). Bench item: -12V start-up into the real rack.

response_us.total_after_crossing: ~3 us + RC; then U5 off, rails decay

ov_guard.note: The bands are threshold screens, not a peak-voltage guarantee: opening U5 does not stop the energy already stored behind it (hs_short). The +5V band overlaps the TPS62933F OVP band (non-latching, stops the high side); either may act first on a slow excursion. A false trip latches every rail off (MAIN off, press RESET). Common-mode: both comparator inputs sit at ~1.24 V at a positive trip, inside (V+) - 1.5 V at 25 C; the -12V channel compares around 0 V.

ov_reference.earliest_rail_rise_ms: > 12 (TPS3808 open-CT POR minimum) + U5 ramp + converter soft start
ov_reference.stability: TLV431 is stable without a capacitor; 10u X5R (~9 uF at 1.24 V) is right of the oscillation region (~3 nF..1 uF at VKA = VREF, SLVS139Z Fig. 5-18; Fig. 5-19 phase margin ~25-40 deg at 0.4-1.5 mA)

S8_without_clamp.note: S8: R98 7.5k to V3V3, R99 47k to -12V, no clamp

ov_clamp.note: BAT54SL VF <= 0.24 V at 0.1 mA (25 C): U20 pin 9 stays above the -0.3 V input limit at room temperature (VF rises ~2 mV/C when cold); U20 is unpowered in this state, so its output state does not matter, only the input current (tens of uA, limit -50 mA). In normal operation the diode is reverse biased by 0.14 V and by ~0 V at the trip point, so its leakage does not move the threshold.

hs_short.note: Lossless bounds WITHOUT the crowbar (the S8.1 screen, kept for comparison). +5V: with less than ~0.6 mF of rack capacitance (~1.3 mF for the undamped bound) the stored charge alone lifts the rail past 6 V after U5 opens; D21 SMAJ5.0A clamps it from its 6.4-7.0 V breakdown. S8.2 adds the Q11 crowbar: see crowbar.hs_short_time_domain. +12V: ~0.02 mF of rack capacitance keeps Vf under 16 V (~0.12 mF for the undamped bound); there is no +12V clamp or crowbar

trigger.U22_cathode_max_V: +5V itself while U22 is off: up to ~10 V (D21 at 30-56 A, hs_short_time_domain) before the SCR fires; TLVH432 18 V (TLV431 would be 7 V abs max)

gate.note: IGT max x 1.9 at -40 C (Fig. 6); VGT assumed 0.93 V at -40 C (+2 mV/C). Strong gate drive also helps the SCR spread its turn-on (dI/dt rating is given at IG = 2 x IGT)

latch_link.note: Q13 must sink 0.25 mA from R97 (OV_N < 0.9 V) with hFE >= 50; the SCR cannot fire before CROW_DRV reaches VGT x (1 + R104/R105). VGT minimum is not specified: 0.30 V at 125 C is a screening assumption. U5 then opens through FAULT even if the guard comparator never sees the overvoltage

hs_short_time_domain.model: Explicit-Euler screen of a hard high-side short of U3 at t = 0: VIN (C_in, fed by U5 at its 4.698 A limit until it opens) -> shorted FET -> SW -> L2 -> +5V bank (C5) with D21 (VBR + 50 mOhm), optional rack branch, no load. SW cannot fall below -0.7 V (U3 low-side body diode: L2 then freewheels from GND) and +5V not below -0.3 V (D3 SS34 from GND). The U20 guard (band max, RC tau) opens U5 t_u5 after its node crosses; the crowbar node (band max, same tau) fires the SCR t_fire later (TLVH432 + Q12 + SCR turn-on) and its latch link opens U5 t_link later. SCR: Vt0 + Rd x I behind 15 nH / 5 mOhm of bank-to-Q11 copper, forward current only, drops out below IH.
hs_short_time_domain.note: The crowbar cannot stop the first microseconds: the rail passes 6 V about 3-4 us after a hard short and D21 holds it at 8-10 V until the 8 us RC + trigger fire the SCR (8-11 us). Within ~1.5 us of firing +5V is under 5 V, after ~3-5 us under ~3.5 V; the SCR then carries the VIN charge and the L2 current (50-75 A, +5V ~2.5-3.5 V falling to ~1 V; the U3 low-side body diode takes L2 over once VIN is empty) and drops out below IH after 40-95 us with +5V near 0 V; D3 holds the remaining ring above -0.4 V. Without it D21 held the rail above 6 V for 29-65 us (S8.1). L2 (SLO1040, Isat 16 A) saturates in this fault: the 1 uH case bounds the faster, higher dump

surge.ITSM_short_pulse: Fig. 11: ~750 A at 0.1 ms; shorter pulses follow the dotted 50 A/us dI/dt line (~250 A at 10 us)
surge.di_dt: The onboard bank (at 8-10 V when Q11 fires) discharges into Q11 at up to ~500-600 A/us through the 15 nH loop in this screen, ~10 x the TS1220 dI/dt rating (50 A/us: 60 Hz repetitive, 125 C, IG = 2 x IGT, which also limits Fig. 11 below 0.1 ms). The screen is an upper bound: it has no SCR turn-on time, which slows the real rise. The anode is at <= 10 V instead of hundreds of volts, so the turn-on energy while the conduction area spreads is small (~0.3 mJ), Q12 drives 3-17 x IGT max and I2t is ~0.3 % of the rating. Survival of repeated firing is NOT covered by the rating: bench item. A crowbar SCR that fails, fails short: the rack stays protected and Q11 must be replaced

thermal.case: latch link and guard both fail inside the 0.57 s startup window: U5 feeds its 4.698 A limit into the shorted rail until U18 latches (or U5 overheats)
thermal.note: DPAK on the +5V pour (> 0.5 cm2): Tj rise ~30 C for 0.5 s. Normal crowbar events are tens of mJ. A second supply that keeps feeding the bus (misconnection) is not rated: the SCR then carries that supply's current limit until it fails (normally short)

crowbar.holding: IH <= 5 mA (25 C, RGK 1k; x 0.5 at 125 C): the SCR drops out once U5 is open and the stored charge is gone; RESET restarts normally (and re-fires if the fault is still there)
crowbar.false_trigger: Same nominal and RC as the U20 guard: the band minimum sits above the stacked setpoint + N=16 release; U22 cannot conduct below its threshold and needs no V3V3, so power-up and power-down cannot fire it; R105 1k + R104/Q12 off hold the gate near 0 V (Q12 IDSS 1 uA)

input_budget.note: planning estimate; efficiencies are assumptions, not measurements

connectors.guidance: typical 2.54 mm IDC/ribbon contact ~1 A: use both headers above ~2 A per rail; unequal cable lengths/loads do not split equally

tvs.note: Above VRWM only at the stacked worst-case setpoint; <= ~5 mW even at 1 mA. Transient clamp only (not a 5 V limit): sustained overvoltage is removed by U20 -> FAULT -> U5 and shorted by the Q11 crowbar (S8.2); D21 sets the +5V peak only for the microseconds before Q11 fires
